phase_labels.label: Contracts, resource controls, and GPU pilot

table_contracts.description: Registered completion state of all seven phases.
Registered primary paired C2 minus C1 world-level results.
Required secondary paired C2 minus C0 world-level results.
Gated C2 versus A-FixedSelect mechanism comparisons and capability checks.
Rare-pivotal recall, support-path survival, and noninferiority safeguards.
Entropy and direct visual-clutter profiles with undefined cases retained.
Leiden-CPM community quality, error, count, conductance, and stability results.
Fixed paraphrase and same-evidence contrastive behavior.
Reduced one-switch A-NoContext, A-NoTemporalEpistemic, and A-NoRareGuard results.
Six scripted known-answer revisions and three researcher interface traces.
Descriptive bounded first-novel transfer and full-index operational results.
Complete successful, failed, invalid, timed-out, repaired, and incomplete call inventory.
GPU, RunPod wall-time, memory, storage, token, and service-state accounting.
Frozen-rule qualitative illustrations; these are not confirmatory evidence.

sections.title: Research questions and hypotheses
fixed_text: H1-semantic registers strict qualified-assertion F1 and H1-organization registers ontology-decision macro F1 for C2 versus C1. Rare-pivotal recall is a noncompensable safeguard, not another optimization target.

sections.title: Experimental conditions and construction timing
fixed_text: C0 and C1 construct before query reveal; C2 actively constructs after query reveal; A-FixedSelect uses query-time LLM selection over the complete sealed C1 ontology while construction operations are mechanically forbidden.

sections.title: Temporal qualified-assertion representation
fixed_text: Assertions separate story time, validity time, discourse order, proposition revelation position, spoiler horizon, holder-level epistemic status, confidence, provenance, contextual relevance, and supported why-it-matters text.

sections.title: Synthetic benchmark construction and split
fixed_text: The registered design contains four development worlds and twelve held-out worlds with three same-evidence contexts per held-out world. Held-out execution remains gated on independent condition-blind review.

sections.title: Resource and reproducibility controls
fixed_text: GPU time includes loading, warm-up, failures, repairs, restarts, and inference. Occupied project storage targets at most 25 GB with 5 GB protected headroom.

sections.title: Primary C2 versus C1 results
fixed_text: This confirmatory section will use twelve worlds as independent units, two one-sided paired t-tests, Holm correction, two-sided paired intervals, all 4096 sign-flip assignments, and the registered bootstrap sensitivity.

sections.title: Required C2 versus C0 results
fixed_text: C2 versus the credible deterministic C0 baseline is a required secondary comparison on all retained endpoints.

sections.title: Gated C2 versus A-FixedSelect mechanism results
fixed_text: The mechanism claim is eligible only after the C2-versus-C1 organization gate passes and C2 exceeds mechanically construction-disabled A-FixedSelect on the registered endpoint.

sections.title: Rare-pivotal preservation
fixed_text: Any favorable claim must accompany rare-pivotal qualified-assertion recall and support-path survival; the registered noninferiority loss margin is 0.05.

sections.title: Entropy and visual-clutter profiles
fixed_text: No entropy direction, node count, crossing count, or cluster count is inherently better. Structural profiles must remain beside fidelity, grounding, validity, and rare-pivotal preservation.

sections.title: Community and cluster organization
fixed_text: The registered panel uses Leiden-CPM with AMI, purity, conductance, fragmentation, merging error, descriptive cluster count and modularity, and cross-seed stability.

sections.title: Paraphrase and contrastive behavior
fixed_text: Contrastive decision-change scoring operates over identical evidence and nonselection ontology changes. Paraphrase stability is interpreted conditional on correctness.

sections.title: Reduced ablation results
fixed_text: Only A-NoContext (12 calls), A-NoTemporalEpistemic (8), and A-NoRareGuard (8) are registered, each with a one-switch-only configuration audit.

sections.title: Feedback and interface demonstrations
fixed_text: Six known-answer scripts and three researcher traces demonstrate REFINE_CONTEXT and REQUEST_MERGE_SPLIT. They do not support participant or usability claims.

sections.title: Bounded first-novel transfer study
fixed_text: The planned transfer study uses four preregistered windows, eight bounded same-evidence queries, and one separately labeled full-index operational C2 query. Public examples must use paraphrases and opaque evidence IDs.

sections.title: Runtime, GPU, storage, invalid-output, repair, and failure accounting
fixed_text: Failures and invalid or unrepaired outputs remain visible and intention-to-treat. Final accounting is cumulative across every registered base call, repair, failure, timeout, and GPU-service allocation.

sections.title: Error analysis, negative results, and limitations
fixed_text: The final analysis must retain null and negative findings, all declared error categories, the twelve-world sample limitation, one-model and one-prompt dependence, compute asymmetry, and descriptive-only transfer scope.

sections.title: Exact claim boundaries
fixed_text: Claims are conditional on registered gates and confined to the benchmark, pinned model, frozen prompt, and bounded narrative transfer study.

sections.title: Easy-to-interpret qualitative illustrations
fixed_text: The final report reserves distinct slots for the development tutorial, rare-pivotal fact, temporal or epistemic case, fixed held-out illustration, deterministic failure case, and one or two narrative illustrations. These do not substitute for aggregate efficacy evidence.
